# CBBBioc

Bioconductor interface to Genentech's
[CompBioBench](https://github.com/genentech/compbiobench-runner) — a
benchmark of computational biology questions for evaluating LLM coding
agents (Claude Code, Codex, ...).

`CBBBioc` catalogs the question set (`v1qs`), locates the input files each
question needs in cloud storage (`cbb_url()`), and stages per-question
agent workspaces (`cbb_setup_workspace()`) in the same `workspace/` +
`prompt.md` layout used by
[`compbiobench-runner`](https://github.com/genentech/compbiobench-runner).
See the package vignette for a worked example.

## Installation

```r
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("vjcitn/CBBBioc")
```

## Question catalog

```{r load}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(CBBBioc)
  library(DT)
})
data(v1qs)
```

`v1qs` currently holds `r nrow(v1qs)` questions across these domains:

```{r domtab, results="asis"}
knitr::kable(as.data.frame(table(Domain = v1qs$domain)), row.names = FALSE)
```

`r sum(v1qs$file_paths != "")` of the `r nrow(v1qs)` questions have one or
more associated input files, retrievable via `cbb_url()` and stageable with
`cbb_setup_workspace()`.

### Browse the full catalog

GitHub's markdown renderer strips the JavaScript an interactive table needs,
so the live, searchable/sortable version of this table lives in the package
website's **Question catalog** article, alongside the narrative context and
references for the benchmark:

**[Browse all questions (interactive table)](https://vjcitn.github.io/CBBBioc/articles/question-catalog.html)**

*(the site at <https://vjcitn.github.io/CBBBioc/> is built with
[`pkgdown`](https://pkgdown.r-lib.org/) from this README, the vignettes, and
the function reference; regenerate it with `pkgdown::build_site()`.)*

A plain-text preview of the first few questions, for quick browsing here:

```{r preview, results="asis"}
preview = v1qs[, c("question_id", "domain", "question_style", "question")]
preview$question = ifelse(
  nchar(preview$question) > 90,
  paste0(substr(preview$question, 1, 87), "..."),
  preview$question
)
# render as inline code so bare URLs in the question text are not
# interpreted (and truncated mid-link) as markdown autolinks
preview$question = paste0("`", preview$question, "`")
knitr::kable(head(preview, 10), row.names = FALSE)
```
